verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a managed SaaS with SDKs, a CLI and a console, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Pinecone. The security docs cover RBAC, SSO, audit logs, CMEK and Private Endpoints, which are adjacent controls and not telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
